shared_elements: quadruped animal shown in profile with legs indicated
low-relief animal carved on a flat rectangular stone face
animal placed horizontally along the upper part of the surface
schematic linear/geometric marking accompanying the animal(s)
justification: Both surfaces present flat-relief quadrupeds in strict profile with schematically rendered limbs set along the upper zone of a rectangular face, and both combine those animals with abstract linear motifs, which is a reasonably specific shared convention. However, A shows a single isolated creature above one long sweeping curved line, whereas B stacks several registers of repeated animals over bands of zigzag/net pattern with a further bird-like figure below, so the compositional scheme and the relationships between elements differ substantially.
